steps.en: Open an HTMLSession and GET the page
steps.zh: 开一个 HTMLSession，GET 目标页面

steps.en: Fetches it with a browser-like user agent, following redirects and keeping cookies
steps.zh: 用伪装的浏览器 UA 去取，自动跟重定向、保留 cookie

steps.en: Parses the response into r.html, with page links already collected and made absolute
steps.zh: 把响应解析成 r.html，页面链接已收齐并转成绝对地址

steps.en: Select what you need with a CSS selector (or XPath)
steps.zh: 用 CSS 选择器（或 XPath）挑出要的元素

steps.en: Returns elements whose text, attributes and links are ready to use
steps.zh: 返回元素对象，文本、属性、链接直接可用

value.en: One object fetches and parses — no wiring requests, a parser and URL-joining together
value.zh: 一个对象同时管抓取和解析，不用自己把 requests、解析器和 URL 拼接接到一起

sources: https://github.com/psf/requests-html#readme (Installation: pipenv install requests-html; Tutorial & Usage: HTMLSession, session.get, r.html.links / absolute_links, r.html.find('#about', first=True), xpath; feature list: mocked user-agent, redirects, connection pooling and cookie persistence)
